lines.en: I land and walk forward slowly.
No rush. First I settle my ki.
Which village does this road lead to?

lines.zh: 每次出手前，我都先想想。
lines.en: Before every fight, I think first.
Soles on soil, very light.

lines.zh: 我不敢走太快，怕踩坏东西。
lines.en: I dare not walk fast; I might break something.

lines.zh: 抬头看一眼太阳的位置。
lines.en: I glance up at the sun's position.

lines.zh: 力量一涨，连走路都要小心。
lines.en: Power up, and even walking needs care.
I came from the direction of the temple.
Hands loose, not clenched.
I go around this fallen tree.
A little further and I should arrive.
Standing, trying not to damage the ground.
I press my ki down.
Like this, I count as calm.
My fingers pinch my cuff.
I am wondering if this fight is necessary.

lines.zh: 这股力量，控制起来很费神。
lines.en: This power takes effort to hold.
Deep breath. Once, twice.
No bird dares land nearby.
I raise a hand, then lower it.
I hope this time needs no fighting.

lines.zh: 气在身体周围薄薄一层。
lines.en: A thin aura surrounds me.
I recall my childhood training.

lines.zh: 我的眼镜不在，看远处有点糊。
lines.en: No glasses, so distance is a blur.
Standing long leaves shallow prints.
Were you sent here too?
I do not want to raise a hand to you.
Tell me your purpose first.
Your ki is tense.
Stand back. I fear a slip.
You're counting how many steps I need to strike.

lines.zh: 如果只是路过，我让你过。
lines.en: If you are only passing, I will let you pass.
Do you really mean to fight me?
I can give you one chance.
Your hand guards your chest.
Once I throw it, it is hard to stop.
Do not force my decision.

lines.zh: 我看起来不像强者，对吧。
lines.en: I do not look strong, do I?
I am only a scholar.
Step back and I will not follow.

lines.zh: 你握拳的样子，像我以前。
lines.en: The way you clench your fists, I used to do that.
I count to three. You can still leave.
I have decided.
That one landed hard.
Blood drips from my arm.
I am still in control.
A little pain is a good sign.
I pull my strength back further.
My clothes are torn.
I withstood it.
Do not break the trees nearby.
I will remember that move.
Is that a book? Let me see.
I do not much need food.
This notebook is interesting.
What would you trade that for?
I dislike taking things by force.
Just put it on the ground.
That would distract me.

lines.zh: 书页比拳头更让我安心。
lines.en: Pages calm me more than fists.
I accept it. Thank you.
Do not try to lure me with food.
Are you all right? Steady.
I step back a little.
That was not a heavy bump.
I did not control my strength well.

lines.zh: 你撞上来那一下，我几乎没动。
lines.en: You hit me and I barely moved.
Steady. Let me help you up.
Do not walk so close; you will trip.
Let us each give a step.
That is not among my concerns.
I am only thinking of training.
I have not thought of a family.
Sorry. I cannot agree.
That is far too early.
I would rather steady my power first.
Please say no more of it.
I have people to protect already.
Let us speak of it later.
A book on the ground. Let me look.
Do not let the pages get wet.
What is written here?
I bend, careful and light.
A fragment. It might be useful.
I put it in my pocket.
This is not mine. I will return it.
I keep the seed on the ground.
One squeeze and it would crumble.
I will keep it here so it is not lost.
Since you struck first.
Then there is no choice.
My ki is gathered.

lines.zh: 气已经聚在掌心，收不回了。
lines.en: The ki is gathered in my palm; it can't be pulled back.
I will try not to kill you.
I have trained this for years.
Your position is not good.

lines.zh: 后面那栋房子，我会避开。
lines.en: I will avoid the house behind you.
Come forward. Do not retreat.
I strike first. Do not blame me.
The blast has formed.
Do not run back. There are people there.
Afterimage Fist. I am moving.
I can only use half my strength.
The target is set.
I do not want to regret this.

lines.zh: 我尽量不看他手上的武器。
lines.en: I try not to stare at his weapon.
His ki is gathering.
A blast spins in my palm.
I will give him one more moment.
His foot slid forward.
The trees behind must not fall.

lines.zh: 究极的力量，压着不发作。
lines.en: Ultimate power, held back.
That move can be softened.
You still have a chance to retreat.

lines.zh: 气功波的角度要低一点。
lines.en: The wave should angle lower.
I watch the stones under his feet.
Any closer and I cannot hold back.
His palms are sweating.
I will pull this one.
Good. Right here.
My hand is up.
Do not stand before that wall.
Meteor combo, first hit.
A burst of blasts, pressing in.
Kamehameha at a third strength.
Ki charge rush, too fast to see.
An elbow, not a fist.
I held back on that kick.
The shockwave grazes his shoulder.
He retreats. I stop.
Three hits, then I stop.
The wave pushes him back two steps.
I ram with my shoulder.
My afterimage stays put.
His armor dented.
Again, heavier this time.
I dare not use full power.
I stop and see if he can stand.
I come down from the sky.

lines.zh: 这具身体，力量压得我难受。
lines.en: This power weighs on me.

lines.zh: 落地的土，被我踩出浅坑。
lines.en: My landing leaves a shallow pit.
I have walked this road a long time.
Where are your people?
Let me look around first.
I cannot hold the ki in. Sorry.
There are other presences nearby.
I will try not to damage this place.
Steady first, then we talk.

lines.zh: 我不是那副眼镜的样子了。
lines.en: I am not the boy with glasses anymore.
Wind lifts my sleeves.
The ground trembles faintly.
I have come down from the sky.
Please stand aside.
I hope this time we can talk.
Fire comes; my ki blocks it.
From the air, my feet are numb.
Ki is hard to move underwater.
The blast hits my chest.
An arrow in my shoulder. Out it comes.
This is not the way of ki.
When hungry, my ki wavers.
Current runs from fingertip to arm.
The ground is gone. I try to fly.
